title: A Patchwise Local Fourier Extension Method for Function Approximation on General Two-Dimensional Domains
summary: We propose a patchwise local Fourier extension method for approximating smooth functions on general two dimensional domains with curved boundaries. The domain is embedded into a Cartesian background grid and decomposed into rectangular interior patches and one-side curved trapezoidal boundary patches. After local data transfer, all patches are converted into fixed-size tensor-product arrays and approximated by a truncated-SVD stabilized local Fourier extension procedure.
